notes.title: First Hotfix Updates! - 1
notes.notes:
[b]This is are the first update for the game![/b]
This update are focused on fixing the bugs that have been reported or found internally by the developer.
Some of bugs are got missed while Quality Control :<
Here are the changes:

[b]Bug Fix:[/b]
[b]- FIXED / REWRITE the Keybinding Feature[/b]
- Fixed Music in the day 12 got overwrited by daily music's
- Fixed the random floffies text in the mitter that still appeared after day 10
- Fixed Thunder sfx that got muted after rain
- Fixed Perks Item Being usable
- Fixed the "Ready to go out?" Dialogue error
- Fixed the broken lamp still generated after day 12
- Fixed the settings save file
- Slapping Simequids that I already tell to not spawn in balcony
- Fixed Bright Bullet while in the balcony
- Fixed Simequids before the ending that did not spawned

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Now day 12 is moving 20% faster
- Small tutorial text changes in Designer Freelance Minigames
